decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core upholstery offer with a dedicated product page, it likely meets or stays near aspiration levels and there is little reason for problemistic search away from it so soon after launch.

Although only mentioned rather than strongly featured, it is still close to the established decorative range, so a medium-sized design-led textile firm would usually give it more time unless clearer underperformance appears.
Its own page and its functional flame-retardant profile fit the firm's contract and hospitality business well, making continued retention likely while management learns more about market acceptance.

This product builds on the existing decoration line but was not especially highlighted, so it faces some review risk, yet boundedly rational management with some slack would usually keep such a recent adjacent launch for another cycle.

Because it is a more niche wool bouclé leno fabric and only lightly presented on the website, it has the highest risk of falling below aspiration, but its fit with the firm's design tradition still makes short-run continuation more likely than withdrawal.
